verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing support for shaping application forms. Workable offers a no-code careers page with auto-fill applications and translated application forms. A team that wants its own form can keep it and push candidates into Workable through the candidates API, which is an extra-tooling workaround rather than native form building. Missing for 10: native custom-question builder, knockout or disqualification rules, EEOC/demographic collection and compliance handling, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
